title: First 14 Days — Experience Blueprint & Interview Evidence Wallet (People Ops)
body:
Purpose:
This is a compact, pragmatic blueprint for the first 14 days of hiring -> handoff -> early onboarding.  Focus is on creating a repeatable candidate experience, reducing manager guesswork, and capturing an "evidence wallet" (portable artifacts that justify hire decisions and speed future role handoffs).

Scope:
- Target: ICs and first-line managers across Eng, Product, and Design (specially tuned for small-to-mid teams).
- Not included: long-form L&D curricula, compensation negotiation playbooks, or relocation logistics (separate flows).

Quick summary (TL;DR):
- Preboarding checklist for hiring & people ops to complete before start date.
- Day 0 -> Day 14 schedule with micro-deliverables rather than generic "getting started" items.
- Interview Evidence Wallet: a short list of artifacts to collect and store with the candidate record.
- Manager + Buddy quick checks to reduce early churn risk.
- Success metrics and simple measurement plan for the cohort.

Owner & review cadence:
- Owner: Asha Patel (People Ops)
- Review: cohort retrospective after each 10 hires or monthly, whichever comes first.

PRE-BOARD (1–5 days before start) — must-dos (people-ops + hiring manager):
- Offer packet & role folder confirmed in HRIS (double-check title, manager, start date, working location).
- Access: create account seeds (email, Slack, core SSO) and share arrival instructions + first-week agenda.
- Hardware orders requested and tracked: expected delivery date documented in candidate record.
- Role context doc: hiring manager writes 1-page "first 90-day focus" and 3 immediate expectations. Save to role folder.
- Evidence wallet seeded: collect final interview panel notes, coding/homework link, and recruiting scorecard. (This is required for start.)
- Buddy assigned & introduced by email with clear expectations.

DAY 0 (onboarding day) — goals: orientation, relationship fixes, immediate wins
- Morning: 30m orientation (People Ops) + 30m manager welcome (team norms + 1-pager).
- Lunch: team intro + low-pressure social (virtual if remote).
- Afternoon: access verification (tools, repo read access, CI) and first micro task assigned (see micro-deliverables).
- Deliverable: evidence wallet updated with manager's initial onboarding note (short), buddy introduction note, and confirmation of tool access.

DAY 1–7 (ramp week) — goals: context, micro-impact, feedback loops
- Micro-deliverables (pick 1–2 depending on role):
  - Engineer: small bugfix + PR with a peer reviewer; include a 1-paragraph description of approach.
  - Product: draft one user story and acceptance criteria for a low-risk improvement.
  - Design: three quick mock variants and rationale for chosen direction.
- Daily syncs: manager 15m check-in each morning, buddy 20m alternating days.
- Document: "first-week decisions" note — what the new hire changed/learned and any blockers. Add to evidence wallet.
- Interview evidence update: attach initial PR link / design files / doc drafts, annotate which interview signals predicted success. (This helps calibrate future hiring.)

DAY 8–14 (stability & priorities) — goals: measurable contribution & 1:1 rhythm
- Deliverable: finish one micro-impact item end-to-end (from spec to review). Manager + reviewer leave actionable notes.
- 1:1 cadence: schedule recurring 30m weekly 1:1 starting week 2 (agenda template in role folder).
- Check-in: people-ops quick pulse (5–10m) to capture early temperature and any paperwork issues.
- Evidence wallet: manager writes a short "early signal" evaluation (skills / company fit / suggested supports).

INTERVIEW EVIDENCE WALLET — minimum artifacts to capture and store with hire record:
- Final panel summary (recruiter + interviewer highlights, 200–400 words).
- Scorecard snapshot: raw numeric scores + short rationales for top/bottom marks.
- Work sample links: coding PRs, take-home artifact, slide deck, Figma links.
- Onboarding micro-deliverable links + reviewer comments.
- Manager early-signal note (end of week 2).
- Candidate-sent notes: expectations, role clarifying questions, and "my 90-day plan" (encouraged during preboarding).
- Any flagged concerns + mitigation plan (if applicable).

Why the wallet matters (short):
- Reuse: faster re-hire/hire-to-hire handoffs when people move roles or teams.
- Calibration: ties interview signals to early outcomes for better interviewer training.
- Compliance + audits: compact record for funding/comp/seniority decisions.

MANAGER CHECKLIST (quick actionable items):
- Before start: write 1-pager "first 90-day focus" and assign buddy.
- Day 0: clear first micro-task and reviewer; confirm access with engineering/platform.
- Week 1: daily 15m check-ins, collect micro-deliverables, set recurring 1:1.
- Week 2: early-signal note + update role backlog with first priority.
- 30d: schedule formal 30-day check with People Ops to capture qualitative signals.

BUDDY CHECKLIST (peer-level playbook):
- Day 0: 30m orientation tour of team repos, CI, deploy, and common quick wins.
- Week 1: pair on PR or task for at least 2 focused sessions.
- Be the default for "where is X" questions — not subject-matter mentor but orientation helper.

MEASUREMENT & KPIs (simple, cohort-level):
- Time to first merged PR / delivered micro-task (days).
- Manager satisfaction (1–5) at 14 days (pulse).
- New hire self-rated clarity (1–5) at 14 days.
- Evidence wallet completeness rate (% hires with all artifacts attached).

RISKS & MITIGATIONS (early churn signals):
- Risk: unclear expectations -> Mitigation: require manager 1-pager preboarding + manager buddy intro.
- Risk: access delays -> Mitigation: gating checklist for Day 0; delay escalation to SRE/IT on day -1.
- Risk: skill mismatch -> Mitigation: micro-deliverable as early diagnostic; if red flags appear, escalate to People Ops for remediation plan.

OPERATING NOTES & TEMPLATES (links / snippets to copy-paste):
- Manager 1-pager template (to be placed in role folder): 3 bullets: business impact, top 3 priorities (90d), required success signals.
- 1:1 agenda (starter): wins / blockers / career / admin.
- Micro-task template: context, acceptance criteria, reviewer, timeline.

OPEN QUESTIONS & DECISIONS NEEDED (workshopping notes):
- How strict should evidence wallet completeness be for external hires vs internal transfers? (proposal: require for external; optional for internal).
- Should hiring managers be scored on wallet completeness during calibration cycles? (tradeoffs: enforcement vs. overhead).
- Storage: canonical place for evidence wallet — currently propose a nested HRIS "attachments" area + cross-link to Confluence role pages. Need platform review.

NOTES TO SELF (informal):
- Shorten manager 1-pager to a single A4 one-liner + 3 bullets — uptake improves.
- Consider a "first-week pairing stipend" to incentivize buddies for high-quality onboarding time.

NEXT STEPS / ACTION ITEMS:
- People Ops to pilot blueprint with next 8 hires across Eng/Product (owner: Asha).
- Engineering managers Miles & Priya to iterate micro-task templates for infra vs product teams.
- Add a field to ATS for "evidence wallet completed" and track for the cohort.

Appendix: quick templates (paste-ready)
- Manager 1-pager:
  Title: Role + Team
  1-liner mission: 15 words max
  Top 3 90d priorities:
  - Priority 1 (why it matters)
  - Priority 2 (why it matters)
  - Priority 3 (why it matters)
  Success markers (by 30/60/90): 1–3 bullets

- Micro-task email to new hire:
  Subject: Quick first task + reviewer
  Hi [name] — welcome. Please take a look at [repo/board] and pick one of the small tasks labelled "onboard-micro". Target: 2–4 hours. Reviewer: [name]. Please attach PR link to your evidence wallet and ping me if blocked.

End of doc.
